== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata 2)]] (Virtual Block 7.1), showing the '''PC-E2''' game text. No published image shows this text; the other versions of the card are [[Massassi Base Sentry]] (original); [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata)]] (PC-E1); [[Massassi Base Sentry (Errata 3)]] (PC-E3).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list writes icons out; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E2 text:''' “Deploy on Yavin 4; it is 'liberated.' At sites related to other 'liberated' systems, may add 2 to power of each Rebel warrior (to a maximum of 4). Once per turn, while you control this system, may retrieve 1 Force when you Force drain at another 'liberated' system.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1007_L5726</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>1_68</code>, title, lore, icons, Virtual Block 7 set mark) with the PC-E2 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
